# Clang -fprofile-list for the Coverage job (.github/workflows/build.yml).
#
# Instrument every function except inline code from third-party headers.
# Eigen's expression templates are inlined into every solver loop, and their
# counters made instrumented tests about 17x slower than Release on CI. The
# coverage report already drops these headers (/usr/ in
# -ignore-filename-regex), so excluding them loses no data.
#
# Patterns match mangled names: src: patterns see the translation unit, not
# the header a function comes from. Clang 18 ignores the newer "[clang]" and
# "=skip" syntax, so this uses an allow list with negations.
fun:*
!fun:_ZN5Eigen*
!fun:_ZNK5Eigen*
!fun:_ZSt*
!fun:_ZNSt*
!fun:_ZNKSt*
!fun:_ZN7testing*
!fun:_ZNK7testing*
!fun:_ZN6google*
!fun:_ZNK6google*
!fun:_ZN4grpc*
!fun:_ZNK4grpc*
# x86 SIMD intrinsics (static inline in Clang's headers), inside Eigen kernels.
!fun:_ZL*_mm*
